segments.he: וְכֵן שׁוֹמֶרֶת יוֹם כְּנֶגֶד יוֹם לֹא תִּטְבּוֹל עַד שֶׁתָּנֵץ הַחַמָּה וְכוּ׳. פְּשִׁיטָא! מַאי שְׁנָא שׁוֹמֶרֶת יוֹם כְּנֶגֶד יוֹם מִכׇּל חַיָּיבֵי טְבִילוֹת!
segments.en: § The mishna states: «And also a woman who observes a day for a day may not immerse herself until the sun has risen.» The Gemara asks: This «is obvious. What is different about a woman who observes a day for a day,» who must immerse herself in a ritual bath, «from all the others who are obligated to immerse themselves,» as it was already taught that one may not immerse himself in a ritual bath until it is day?

moves.summary: Lemma on the woman observing a day for a day
Obvious: she is like all who must immerse
moves.about: the woman observing a day for a day is already covered by the general rule on immersion
